name: Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited

timeline.x: [Amalgamation/Merger] Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited has submitted the Exchange the Voting Results and the Scrutinizer's Report of the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal ("NCLT") Convened Meeting of the Unsecured Creditors of Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited held on November 13, 2026

[Amalgamation/Merger] Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Proceedings of the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal ("NCLT") Convened Meeting of the Unsecured Creditors of Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited held on November 13, 2026

[Amalgamation/Merger] Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of Observation Letter conveying no objection from National Stock Exchange of India Limited in connection with the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation of Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited with and into Kothari Petrochemicals Limited
